title: Spider-Man Remastered in FULL VR! I swing with my OWN ARMS! Free mod, early alpha made with Claude and Astra
author: liansk
selftext:
Ilya's Spiderman Remastered VR early public alpha is out and I'm SO hyped to finally share it. LET'S GOOOOO!!!

**Download (free):** [https://github.com/IlyaMez/SpidyVR/releases/latest](https://github.com/IlyaMez/SpidyVR/releases/latest)

**Discord:** [https://discord.gg/x27ZXDpdNt](https://discord.gg/x27ZXDpdNt)

**What we have so far**

\- Native stereo at your headset's resolution, 6DoF head and hands

\- Physical web swinging: squeeze a grip to fire a web where you point, swing, reel in with the trigger, pull sharply to zip. Webs hold on buildings, the ground, or open air

\- Web shooter: a free hand's trigger fires the game's own web ball from your wrist

\- Grab and throw: web a prop or a thug, yank it in, swing it, let go to throw

\- Look down and you see Spider-Man's body; his arms follow your controllers

\- Real punches: a fast fist into a thug lands the game's own hit

\- VR settings panel in the headset, menus and cutscenes on a virtual screen

\- One-click launcher that checks your PC and starts VR. It changes nothing in the game folder

\*\*What you need\*\*

\- Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered on \*\*Steam\*\* (Epic is a different build)

\- A PC VR headset with an OpenXR runtime. I play on Quest 3 over Virtual Desktop. SteamVR and Quest Link should work but are untested, so reports from those are gold

\- About 19 GB of memory for programs (RAM plus page file)

It's an alpha, so expect rough edges. If something breaks, the launcher saves a session report in its reports folder. Drop it in the Discord and I'll dig in.

Fan project, not affiliated with Insomniac, Sony or Marvel.
